title: NTSignalMeasurement
description: The machine-liftable measurement payload for NT_SIGNAL hyperedges. Spec Addendum NT-Signal-Measurement §2. Wire format half of the NT_SIGNAL ↔ Edda Measurement[PhysicalQuantity] co-design.

quantity_kind.description: The physical quantity kind. MUST be a registered kind in the registry version named by registry_version. Mutually exclusive with extended_quantity_kind.

extended_quantity_kind.description: Tenant-specific quantity kind outside the registry. Mutually exclusive with quantity_kind. Opaque to cross-tenant significance matching. §5.4.

value.description: The measured value. Numeric — never a string.

uncertainty.description: Instrument precision, asymmetric. plus/minus are non-negative magnitudes (σ above / σ below). §2.

confidence.description: Extraction fidelity — the lift's self-assessment of how reliably value+uncertainty were extracted from the source. Distinct from uncertainty (instrument precision). §4.

unit_system.description: Explicit unit system. Never implied. e.g. si, natural, dimensionless.

registry_version.description: The quantity-kind registry version the signal was emitted under. §6.
